resumeText:
Kavya Reddy | Hyderabad | kavya.reddy@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Research Executive, Charminar Insights Pvt Ltd, Hyderabad (2022 - present)
- Designed questionnaires for brand tracking and concept testing studies for FMCG and auto clients.
- Briefed field teams and monitored quotas and back-checks across six cities.
- Analysed survey data in SPSS, running t-tests and chi-square tests on key measures.
- Wrote tabulation specs and checked banner tables from the data processing team.
- Wrote topline reports and client debrief decks with key findings and recommendations.
- Cleaned raw survey data and built charts in Excel for client decks.
- Presented findings to client brand teams in debrief meetings.

Research Trainee, Deccan Field Research, Hyderabad (2021 - 2022)
- Supported CAPI fieldwork in Telangana towns and checked completed interviews.

EDUCATION
MA Economics, University of Hyderabad, 2021

SKILLS
FGD moderation, Questionnaire design, PowerPoint
